New in this update:

• The Academy — run a course from waterbugblitz.org.au, enter its session code, identify a set of waterbugs, compare your answers and earn a belt. Your belt shows on the home screen and in your account.
• Sync your surveys whenever you like, with the new Sync button on Survey History.
• An account screen showing your details and the belts you've earned, where you can also delete your account.
• Better use of the screen on tablets.
